meta.name: board-memo
meta.description: Draft a board or executive summary of an engagement using outcomes, risks and investment decisions. Use when the sponsor needs to brief senior leadership.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目成果、风险与投入决策整理成一份给高层看的简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目结束后要向管理层或投资人总结成果与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn engagement outcomes, risks, and investment decisions into a board-ready summary
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must brief senior leadership on results and risks

howto.what: 依据成果、风险和投资决策,起草某次项目的董事会或高管层摘要。若由 @fde 调用,它会复用对方当前已脱敏的信息包和范围,不重新开始设置或提问。
howto.when: 当赞助人需要向高层领导汇报时触发。若被 @fde 调用,则接管并沿用已有上下文和范围。

say.text: 根据这次的成果、风险和投资决策,帮我起草一份董事会摘要。
赞助人要向高层汇报,把这次项目写成高管摘要。
say.note: 从已提供的上下文起草。

say.text: 摘要里没确认的项保留为未知,别写成已验收。
say.note: 保留未知项并区分各阶段。

howto.what_en: Drafts a board or executive summary of an engagement from outcomes, risks and investment decisions. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the sponsor needs to brief senior leadership, or when @fde calls it and it takes over using the existing context and scope.

say_en.text: Draft a board summary from this engagement's outcomes, risks and decisions.
The sponsor needs to brief senior leadership - write the executive summary.
Keep unconfirmed items as unknowns in this memo, not accepted.
